header.running_head: The Importance Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) Attached to the Nawaafil Salaahs between Sunrise and Midday

blocks.text: performs wudhu properly, proceeds to the Masjid to perform the Fajr salaah and then follows this up with performing the Salaatud Duhaa. Such a person returns even quicker with an even larger booty." [^1]
Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) and Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) Perform Salaatud Duhaa
Hadhrat Ataa Abu Muhammad says that he saw Hadhrat Ali (RA) performing the Salaatud Duhaa in the Masjid. [^2]
Hadhrat Ikramah reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) would perform the Salaatud Duhaa once every ten days. [^3]
The daughter of Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA), Hadhrat Aa'isha narrates that (her father) Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) used to perform eight Rakaahs of Salaatud Duhaa. [^4]
The Importance Attached to the Nawaafil Between Zuhr and Asr

Hadhrat Sha'bi reports that although Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) did not perform the Salaatud Duhaa, he performed Nawaafil salaahs between Zuhr and Asr together with the long shift he took at night. [^5]
Hadhrat Naafi narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) engaged himself in salaah between Zuhr and Asr. [^6]
The Importance Attached to the Nawaafil Between Maghrib and Isha
The Salaah Rasulullaah ﷺ Performs salaah between Maghrib and Isha and the Salaah of Hadhrat Ammaar (RA)
Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) says, "I went to Rasulullaah ﷺ and performed the Maghrib salaah with him. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ continued performing salaah until Isha. [^7]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ammaar bin Yaasir
